changeNote: First release in the yaah pack.
name: sql-editor
description: A SQL editor on one of the user's database connections, for exploring data together: highlighting, completion of real table and column names, ⌘↵ to run, results as a sortable table, a history of runs, and "Send to chat" so the user can hand a query and its result back to you. Runs read-only. Start it with the query you suggest; render again with the same id and new `sql` to rewrite it.

props.title: Top customers by spend
props.sql:
select c.name, count(*) as orders, sum(o.quantity * p.price_cents) / 100.0 as spent
from orders o
join customers c on c.id = o.customer_id
join products p on p.id = o.product_id
group by c.name
order by spent desc
limit 10
